prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1201; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute low back pain radiating into the left buttock, with associated muscle spasm and reduced range of motion. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar flexion and extension. Neurological screening was intact, with no motor deficit, sensory loss, or reflex changes. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Treatment consisted of a structured course of physical therapy, including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, graduated core stabilization exercises, and home exercise instruction. Patient was also prescribed short-term anti-inflammatory medication and muscle relaxant as needed. Over the course of 20 visits, the patient showed steady improvement in pain scores, lumbar mobility, and functional tolerance for sitting and lifting.

At the most recent reassessment, residual mild stiffness persisted with occasional discomfort on prolonged sitting, but the patient was functioning near baseline and returning to usual work and daily activities. Discharge to an independent home exercise program was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
